in_hindi.name: हिरन्मयी

in_marathi.name: Hiranmayi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hiranmayi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hiranmayi is derived from the Sanskrit words 'hiran' (gold) and 'maa' (goddess). The name signifies the golden goddess who bestows wealth and prosperity upon her devotees.
